title: Sign-up email link arrives and signs you in
instructions: On https://proactive-zeta-three.vercel.app/auth/signup, sign up with a real inbox you control (e.g. you+proactive@gmail.com). The email should arrive within a minute and clicking it should land on the disclaimer or onboarding. Afterwards remove the test account from Proactive's admin page.

title: Upgrading through Stripe checkout unlocks the plan
instructions: With a test account, go to Account → Manage plan and upgrade to Entry (Stripe test mode, card 4242 4242 4242 4242). After returning, the plan shows Entry and the Entry features open. Cancel the subscription afterwards.

title: Daily reminder email arrives
instructions: With a test account, turn on the daily reminder in Account → Notifications for a time a few minutes ahead. The reminder email should arrive then and its link should open the app.

title: Collaborator gives a sensible real reply
instructions: The automated tests simulate Collaborator (no real AI calls). Occasionally, with a Premium/test account, run Prioritization, click "Personalize with Collaborator", and confirm the reply is sensible and on-brand.
